ChatSettings.description: The possible settings for a chat Completion

maxTokens.description: The maximum tokens for the prompt

stream.description: Stream the response in real time

presencePenalty.description: Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

stop.description: Up to 4 sequences where the API will stop generating further tokens.

frequencyPenalty.description: Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

topP.description: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

temperature.description: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.

seed.description: Seed used for sampling. The provider attempts to return the same response to the same request with an identical seed.

requestStartTime.description: The time the request was received by the API seconds since epoch

providerStartTime.description: The time the request was opened with the LLM provider

requestEndTime.description: The time the response was sent back to the client

url.description: Either a URL of the image or the base64 encoded image data.

start.description: The start position of the detected text.

end.description: The end position of the detected text.

MessageDataType.description: The type of the message data.

reason.description: The reason for the intent decision

safeGuardDetails.description: Guard Rails Details for the message

toolCalls.description: Tool calls generated by the model (for assistant messages)

toolCallId.description: Tool call ID that this message is responding to (for tool role messages)

FunctionParameters.description: JSON Schema defining the parameters the function accepts

name.description: The name of the function to be called. Must be a-z, A-Z, 0-9, or contain underscores and dashes, with a maximum length of 64.

description.description: A description of what the function does, used by the model to choose when and how to call the function.

type.description: The type of the tool. Currently, only 'function' is supported.

ToolChoiceString.description: Controls which (if any) tool is called by the model. 'none' means the model will not call any tool. 'auto' means the model can pick between generating a message or calling one or more tools. 'required' means the model must call one or more tools.

ToolChoiceFunction.description: Specifies a tool the model should use. Use to force the model to call a specific function.

name.description: The name of the function to call.

ToolCallFunction.description: The function that the model called

name.description: The name of the function to call.

arguments.description: The arguments to call the function with, as generated by the model in JSON format.

id.description: The ID of the tool call.

SafeGuardSettings.description: The SafeGuard settings used for the chat

modelId.description: Model ID used for the chat

tools.description: A list of tools the model may call. Currently, only functions are supported as a tool. Use this to provide a list of functions the model may generate JSON inputs for.

toolChoice.description: Controls which (if any) tool is called by the model. 'none' means the model will not call any tool and instead generates a message. 'auto' means the model can pick between generating a message or calling one or more tools. 'required' means the model must call one or more tools. Specifying a particular tool via {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "my_function"}} forces the model to call that tool.
